card.craftbound.zombie.text: %s: add Rotten Flesh to your hand.
card.craftbound.skeleton.text: %s. %s: add an Arrow to your hand.
card.craftbound.creeper.text: %s: explode, dealing 2 damage to every other mob.
card.craftbound.enderman.text: %s: teleport an enemy mob back to its owner's hand.
card.craftbound.charged_creeper.text: %s: explode, dealing 4 damage to every other mob and the enemy hero.
card.craftbound.evoker.text: %s: summon two Vexes. %s: add a Totem of Undying to your hand.
card.craftbound.ravager.text: No ability. It's just very big.
card.craftbound.piglin_brute.text: %s. Takes 1 less damage from every hit.
card.craftbound.shulker.text: %s. %s. Mobs it hits levitate and can't attack on their next turn.
card.craftbound.wither_skeleton.text: Mobs it damages are withered: they take 1 damage at the start of each of their owner's turns.
card.craftbound.enchanted_golden_apple.t: Give a friendly mob invulnerability: it takes no damage until your next turn.
card.craftbound.totem_of_undying.text: Give a friendly mob a Totem. When it dies, it's summoned again.
card.craftbound.warden.text: %s. %s: Sonic Boom, dealing 3 damage to every enemy mob.
card.craftbound.wither.text: %s: deal 2 damage to every other mob. %s: add a Nether Star to your hand.
card.craftbound.ender_dragon.text: %s. %s: add a Dragon Egg to your hand.
keyword.craftbound.sprint.desc: Can attack the turn it's summoned.
keyword.craftbound.ranged.desc: Takes no damage back when it attacks.
keyword.craftbound.spawn.desc: Happens when you play this card.
keyword.craftbound.block.desc: Never attacks or hits back. Does its job until broken.
card_class.craftbound.neutral.desc: Any deck can use this card.
card_class.craftbound.fighter.desc: Only Fighter decks can use this card.
card_class.craftbound.builder.desc: Only Builder decks can use this card.
card_class.craftbound.farmer.desc: Only Farmer decks can use this card.
card_ui.craftbound.mob_type.desc: Mob type. Some cards work better with mobs of the same type.
card_ui.craftbound.attack.desc: Damage this mob deals when it attacks.
card_ui.craftbound.health.desc: Damage this mob can take before it dies.
card_ui.craftbound.rarity.desc: How hard this card is to find in packs.
card_ui.craftbound.enchanted.desc: Enchanted: a rare shiny copy. Plays exactly the same.
card_ui.craftbound.token.desc: Made by other cards. Never found in packs.
card_ui.craftbound.pin_hint: Click to pin or unpin the card it creates.
card_ui.craftbound.number.desc: Its pocket number in the Card Binder.
binder_ui.craftbound.how_to: Click cards onto it in your inventory to file them.
binder_ui.craftbound.hint_take_enchanted: Ctrl+click: take an Enchanted copy (Ctrl+Shift: all)
binder_ui.craftbound.disenchant_hint: A binder keeps 2 normal and 2 Enchanted copies of each card (1 of each for Legendaries). This breaks down anything over that into experience.
match_ui.craftbound.title: Card Match
match_ui.craftbound.status.frozen: Frozen: can't attack on its next turn
match_ui.craftbound.status.withered: Withered: takes 1 damage at the start of each of its owner's turns
match_ui.craftbound.status.totem: Totem of Undying: comes back when it dies
match_ui.craftbound.status.invulnerable: Invulnerable until its owner's next turn
match_ui.craftbound.sit_hint: Right-click the table to play a practice match against the Card Master
match_ui.craftbound.no_deck: Bring a Deck Case to the table to play
match_ui.craftbound.deck_too_small: Pick a class and put at least %s cards in your Deck Case to play
match_ui.craftbound.deck_missing: Your deck lists cards your binders are missing: carry the binder that has them
deck_ui.craftbound.no_cards: No cards here. Try another tab or filter, or file more cards in your binders.
deck_ui.craftbound.missing: Your binders are missing %s of these. Carry the binder that has them to play this deck.
deck_ui.craftbound.pick_class: Pick a class for this deck first.
deck_ui.craftbound.pick_class_title: Choose a class for this deck
deck_ui.craftbound.pick_class_hint: Your deck can use that class's cards plus any Neutral cards.
deck_ui.craftbound.class_blurb.fighter: Swords, fast mobs and all-out attacks.
deck_ui.craftbound.class_blurb.builder: Walls, blocks and Villagers holding the line.
deck_ui.craftbound.class_blurb.farmer: Crops that grow and harvests that pay off.
deck_ui.craftbound.click_to_use: Click to use this card back
deck_ui.craftbound.class_hint: Click to change class. You can't switch while the deck has cards from another class.
deck_ui.craftbound.empty: Click cards on the left to add them to your deck.
deck_ui.craftbound.how_to: Right-click to build your deck from the cards in your binders. Click a sleeve onto it to change your card backs.
deck_ui.craftbound.hint_add: Click or drag to the deck to add (Ctrl: Enchanted)   Right-click: zoom in
deck_ui.craftbound.hint_remove: Click, or drag out of the list, to take it out of the deck (Ctrl: Enchanted). Right-click: zoom in
deck_ui.craftbound.wrong_class: This card belongs to another class.
deck_ui.craftbound.max_copies: You already have the most copies allowed.
deck_ui.craftbound.none_left: Every copy you own is already in this deck.
sleeve_ui.craftbound.desc: A card back design for your Deck Case.
